description: This file contains shell functions and scripts for configuring and managing a QMI-based cellular network interface, particularly for OpenWrt firmware. It includes initialization, setup, and teardown routines, as well as logic for handling SIM card states, network registration, and IP configuration via QMI commands.

methods.name: proto_qmi_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the QMI protocol configuration, defining various parameters related to the cellular connection such as device, APN, authentication, and network profiles.

methods.name: proto_qmi_setup
methods.description: Sets up the cellular interface, performs SIM and network registration checks, configures data profiles, and brings the interface online with IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.

methods.name: qmi_wds_stop
methods.description: Stops the WDS (Wireless Data Service) network connection and releases the client ID.

methods.name: proto_qmi_teardown
methods.description: Teardown routine that stops the network connection, releases resources, and updates the network state.
